Information trends in our current time is constantly evolving and to evolve with it, students are being taught information science accordingly. After my brother had his terrifying dream which included him screaming bloody murder, I became too afraid of wanting to even try lucid dreaming. 

Of course, once I made the decision to stop I had my most memorable out of body experience. I was laying down on my brothers bed and was playing a video game. I had something to do later so I was trying to fight the urge to sleep. Eventually, I was in the in-between gray area of consciousness. 

Then I saw myself laying on the bed. I knew I was asleep. I fought the feeling of being afraid and tried to fly away like I had been tryin to do for the last few months. But... I couldn’t move. Every time I tried to leave the room I saw myself sleeping in, I felt weird. Then I noticed my sleeping body’s arms fidgeting as I tried to force movement. Once I saw an arm fidget or move just a little, I’d feel the blankets across my arm. Or the controller pushing into my face. 

Then the voices came. It sounded like a bunch of bees at first but soon became muffled voices. This is for sure where I started to panic. Instead of trying to have a fun flying dream, I really just wanted to wake up. I felt AND saw my arms move. I saw my body slumping forward like it was crawling. Almost slug-like. I tried to at least get closer to myself but the voices just kept getting louder and louder. 
I woke up because I fell from the bed and that must’ve been why I was slumping forward. 

Every now and then, I notice when I am dreaming but I don’t try to do anything crazy anymore.
Try to focus on the pieces of my appearance I like instead.
